articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA; the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, today reported second quarter 2026 net income of $11.1 million, or $0.64 per diluted common share, compared to first quarter 2026 net income of $10.6 million, or $0.61 per diluted common share, and second quarter 2025 net income of $8.0 million, or $0.47 per diluted common share. articles.title: West Bancorporation, Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Declares Increased Quarterly Dividend
